{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for missing values
missing_values = df.isnull().sum()

# Check unique values in 'site' column
unique_sites = df['site'].unique()

# Check the 'responded' column
responded_counts = df['responded'].value_counts()

# Print results
print("Missing values:", missing_values.to_dict())
print("Unique sites:", unique_sites)
print("Responded value counts:", responded_counts.to_dict())"}
